name: Sophia
source:
An old friend of Ryuku, someone that knows him more than most. She's also a part of the same Clan that Ryuku belongs often times doing covert missions for the cause. Their partnership runs deeper than a conventional one. A hot and heavy partnership that has them at odds of the world they inhabit. A confident woman, she easily stands tall in almost any situation and her steely eyed stare can melt even the most hardened criminal. Ryuku knowing only too well. She may sound flirtatious and carefree, but it usually masks a deeper longing of a peaceful life.

Her favorite flavor is Cherry
She loves to shop for knick-knacks
